verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a fraud and risk engine, since buyers may compare on-prem or self-deployable options, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Adyen Risk Management can be self-hosted. The docs describe a hosted service: settings and case review run in Adyen's Customer Area, and scoring relies on Adyen's global transaction data. The MCP server, APIs and OpenAPI definitions are integration surfaces for that hosted service, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
